scripts.dev: mkdir -p logs && concurrently -p "[{time}] [{name}]" -t "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" -n "agent,runtime,frontend" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev:runtime" "npm run dev:frontend" 2>&1 | tee -a logs/dev.log
scripts.dev:backend: mkdir -p logs && concurrently -p "[{time}] [{name}]" -t "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" -n "agent,runtime" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev:runtime" 2>&1 | tee -a logs/backend.log
